name: OPEE Summer Adventures
description_short: Chicopee's summer day program at Stefanik Elementary School for ages 5 to 13. Weekly themes, sports, games and crafts, swimming three days a week at Ray Ashe pool, a field trip every week, and skits for families on the last day.
refund_policy_summary: Refunds from June 6 to 26, 2026 carry a 25% fee per session; after June 5 a full refund needs medical documentation. No refunds once the program starts on June 29.
swim_waterfront_notes: Recreational swimming Monday, Wednesday and Friday at Ray Ashe pool, or indoors at a local high school in bad weather, with certified lifeguards.
notes: Optional pre program 7:45 to 8:30 am, $50 a session ($40 for session 1). The final two days (August 6 and 7) are at Bellamy Middle School, 314 Pendleton Ave., for the show.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 Parent/Guardian Manual. Ages 5 through 13, Monday to Friday 8:30 am to 4:00 pm at Stefanik Elementary School, 720 Meadow St., Chicopee, MA 01020. Six sessions June 29 to August 7, 2026 (no program July 3); the last two days are at Bellamy Middle School for the show. Optional pre program 7:45 to 8:30 am, $50 a session ($40 session 1). Lunch and afternoon snack provided; bring a morning snack. Field trip entry fees are covered by the weekly fee. Registration online at chicopeerec.com, ends May 29, 2026. The manual does not give the weekly fee.
